candidates.name: Great Lakes Building Specialties (GLBS)
candidates.partition_evidence: Toilet partitions page says 'Installation Available Throughout West Michigan'; homepage offers Division 10 installation in West Michigan with nationwide supply. No project portfolio, only product photos.
red_flags: Authorized ASI dealer that sells partitions nationwide: buy-around risk and direct competitor
Listed email is a named person's address
candidates.reason: Grand Rapids commercial Division 10 company that explicitly installs toilet partitions across West Michigan. Also an ASI dealer, so it competes with Next Partitions on supply.

license.name: Great Lakes Building Specialties (GLBS)
license.registry: City of Grand Rapids Development Center registered contractor list (Power BI directory linked from grandrapidsmi.gov Registered Contractor page)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. The city's registered contractor list is a Power BI report that only shows a loading screen to automated access, so no record could be read. The city's Register Contractor page says registration applies to holders of a State of Michigan license who pull permits in Grand Rapids, plus underground contractors. It mentions no city registration for commercial contractors without a state license. Michigan has no state license for commercial specialty work such as partition installation, and the LARA lookup (Accela) is a search form that could not be run automatically. Confirm by name in the city list or with the Development Center, 616-456-4100 (company-neutral public office line from the city page).

candidates.name: Divis10n (Division 10 Sales)

red_flags: Sells toilet compartments from several brands, including Bobrick, Bradley and Scranton, which Next Partitions also resells: buy-around risk
candidates.reason: Commercial Division 10 supplier and installer in Wyoming, MI that sells toilet compartments and installs Division 10 products. Partition installation itself isn't shown.
